origin.description: The assign attribute on model matrices describes which columns come from which terms. R uses a compact integer vector; this function returns the S-Plus style list.
origin.details: The assign attribute on model matrices describes which columns come from which terms. R uses a compact integer vector; this function returns the S-Plus style list.
origin.value: A list with names for each term and integer vectors of column indices.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(survival))
value <- (function() {
  formula <- Surv(time, status) ~ factor(ph.ecog)
  tt <- terms(formula)
  mf <- model.frame(tt, data = lung)
  mm <- model.matrix(tt, mf)
  aa <- attrassign(mm, tt)
  c(paste(names(aa), collapse = "|"),
    unlist(lapply(aa, function(x) paste(x, collapse = " ")), use.names = FALSE))
})()
cat(paste(value, collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: The assign attribute on model matrices describes which columns come from which terms. R uses a compact integer vector; this function returns the S-Plus style list.
translation.details: Pass a model matrix object with an assign vector and a terms object with term_labels (set is_terms=True on a simple wrapper if needed).
translation.value: An ordered dict with names for each term and integer lists of column indices.
